title: Release gates and operational ownership
scope: Expose local and CI gates for lint/types/tests/build/contracts/PostgreSQL/browser/migration/identity.
Record measured evidence and a concise product decision review.
Operate scoped rollout, alerts, backup/restore, and compatible application recovery.
excluded: Arbitrary line coverage as release evidence
Production deployment without integrations and baseline
invariants: A missing or skipped gate fails the release.
Evidence states command, real exit code, environment, and actual scope.
Only product and contract owners approve unresolved access policy changes.
Recovery cannot restore an old wider permission set.

acceptance.given: The execution graph has a missing dependency, cycle, uncovered requirement, or broken link
acceptance.then: nonzero exit identifies the actionable violation

acceptance.given: Runtime tool or required integration is unavailable
acceptance.then: the gate records failure/blocker rather than success or skip
every stated scenario has implementation evidence and remaining work is labeled
acceptance.evidence: completed evidence map and product alignment

acceptance.given: An access mismatch appears in canary
acceptance.then: rollout stops, affected writes fence, owner investigates, and unaffected accounts continue

acceptance.given: Database is restored to before a later revocation
acceptance.then: traffic remains blocked until durable journal reconciliation prevents restored access

acceptance.given: The synthetic workload runs at steady and burst traffic
acceptance.when: database queues and connection demand grow
acceptance.then: bounded deadlines and backpressure hold; no fail-open policy and measured connection demand fits the budget

acceptance.given: A release candidate contains a dependency or configuration defect
acceptance.then: SBOM, locked dependency audit, threat tests and startup validation block an unreviewed release
acceptance.evidence: G-SECURITY scan and startup failure artifacts

acceptance.given: A required runtime gate is missing, skipped or from another revision
acceptance.then: nonzero exit blocks completion and identifies missing proof

acceptance.given: Access divergence or outbox delay is injected
acceptance.when: alerts and the operator runbook execute
acceptance.then: the owner receives a scoped actionable signal and exercises containment without leaking identifiers into metrics
acceptance.evidence: G-OPERATIONS alert and fault drill evidence

acceptance.given: Engineering standards are reviewed for a milestone
acceptance.when: a technique is applied or deferred
acceptance.then: every standard has rationale, ownership, verification and a revisit condition; decisions never substitute for measured evidence
acceptance.evidence: standards traceability and design review record
